{{Quote|It's because we work and we work and we don't get greensick. No other mining village on Lanteeb can claim that. They don't know our secret. Not Chukba, not Endvo, not Deebin, not even Trahn.|[[Jaklin]]|<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Siege">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege]]''</ref>}}
'''Endvo''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] village that was situated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Endvo was one of various settlements on the world that mined [[Damotite]], an [[Ore/Legends|ore]] that could be used to fuel [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]]-refining plants. However, the inhabitants of Endvo were at a disadvantage to those of the rival mining village [[Torbel]], because they did not possess knowledge of how to evade suffering the effects of Damotite [[Poison/Legends|poisoning]].
